text:
jordan-peopleops: Quick update  we've published two adjacent handbook changes: (1) PTO rollover cap moves from 80 to 120 hours and (2) an annual 12-min anti-harassment refresher is now mandatory for all people managers. Please read both pages and complete the required acknowledgments by Mon 2026-04-20. Links: https://handbook.redwood.com/timeoff/pto-rollover and https://handbook.redwood.com/policies/harassment-refresher

frank-engineering: Question: does the higher rollover cap apply to folks on reduced schedules or contractors?

jordan-peopleops: Good call. Rollover cap applies to payroll employees only; part-timers get a prorated cap based on FTE (example table on the page). Contractors are excluded from PTO policy but we added a contractor wellbeing guidance doc.

maya-manager: For the manager refresher  do managers need to retake if they completed last year?

jordan-peopleops: Yes, annual requirement  everyone with a manager title must complete the 12-min module this year. We'll auto-assign and track completions; managers also get a 1-page checklist for leading inclusive 1:1s.

onboarding-bot: Training assignment created  course "Manager Anti-Harassment Refresher" (12 min) auto-assigned to manager cohort. Reminder schedule: 10 days, 3 days, and 1 day before deadline. Course: https://lms.redwood.com/courses/anti-harassment-2026

frank-engineering: Related ops Q: hiring ops flagged that interview teams want standardized language about PTO expectations for offers. Any copy we can use?

\jm jordan-peopleops: (typo) @frank-engineering good idea  added a new "Offer template language" snippet under Recruiting > Hiring Ops that recruiters can paste into offer emails: "PTO: Redwood provides X hours annual PTO with up to 120 hours rollover (prorated for part-time). Details in the handbook." Feel free to suggest edits.

maya-manager: Managers: will we get a roster of who hasn't completed the manager module? I prefer to follow up in 1:1 rather than mass nag.

\jonboarding-bot: Manager completion roster will be exported and emailed to people managers on 2026-04-21 (one day after final reminder).

sara-legal: Note from Legal  the harassment refresher includes region-specific examples; for EMEA we adjusted wording to match local statute. Managers outside the US should review the localized FAQ.

jordan-peopleops: Also added a short "What to tell your team" blurb for managers and two 1:1 nudge templates (friendly and firm). Example: "Heads-up: new PTO rollover cap and a short manager-only training. Please complete the training by Apr 20; ping me if you need more time"

frank-engineering: Last practical Q: if someone is on leave and misses the deadline, any extension?

\jsara-legal: Exceptions for documented leaves handled case-by-case; documented long leaves get an automatic 30-day extension. We'll note exceptions in the LMS record.

jordan-peopleops: Thanks folks. I'll post a short announcement in #general tomorrow and attach the manager scripts. Ping me with edge cases (international payroll, comp implications). :thumbsup:
